label: Contradiction
evidence: Notwithstanding the return, destruction or erasure of Evaluation Material hereunder, the Receiving Party and its Representatives shall cease to be bound by their confidentiality and other obligations hereunder.
reason: The only clause that addresses whether obligations continue after the deal ends says the parties stop being bound by their confidentiality and other obligations, not that those obligations survive. The agreement has no survival clause that would keep any obligation alive.
